complaint: Engine shakes at idle and the check engine light is on. Scanner shows a misfire on cylinder 2.
Temperature gauge went into the red on the highway and there is steam coming from under the hood.
Car clicks but will not crank in the morning, battery light was on yesterday while driving.
Check engine light is on, fuel economy got worse, I hear a hissing sound near the engine at idle.
Check engine light came on right after I filled up the tank.
Brake pedal goes almost to the floor and the car takes a long time to stop.
Đèn check engine sáng, máy rung khi chạy không tải, tăng ga bị hụt.
Kim nhiệt độ nước làm mát lên cao khi kẹt xe, quạt két nước hình như không quay.
Đèn báo ắc quy sáng khi đang chạy, đèn pha tối dần.
